w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Salvador. Spool, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ CHORUS LINE! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (Ruby lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Cribs: Burrow Edition. The aliens tour a villager's shelter. They are horrified. Then delighted. Then they "improve" one thing."
📺 SYSTEM: "Tonight's program is brought to you by the Meridian Institute. Specimen-grade entertainment. Peer-reviewed."

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
